scope: Disposable synthetic cookie preview in isolated headless contexts. The connected case overrides only the bootstrap JSON on the synthetic host; it does not verify production authentication, central request APIs, accounting or grants.

checks.name: anonymous home and protected workspace use the synthetic cookie bootstrap
consumer sees two organizations and no admin controls or admin authorization
catalog search, center filter and no-results state are functional
plan details preserve a large exact decimal and native modal focus
new request has a timeline and survives reload without a backend write
organization switching isolates requests and usage and restores organization A
current usage amounts remain exact and unavailable previous period is explicit
publication form creates one scoped pending history and persists after reload
RTL tab keyboard behavior and layouts at 1440, 390 and 320 pixels remain usable
explicit admin cookie has an isolated scope and can approve or reject own sample items
denied subject and tampered tenant expose no stale scoped data or enabled mutations
connected bootstrap UI simulation ignores saved preview drafts and disables mutations
failed session persistence warns visibly and keeps current changes until reload
all browser traffic stayed on the preview origin without backend mutations or page errors
